cases.description: Classic LeetCode example — best window is [4,-1,2,1]
Single negative element — must return the element itself, not 0
Whole array is the best subarray
All negative — must return the largest single element (the Kadane gotcha)
Monotonically increasing all-negative — answer is the last element
Reset would lose; carrying the negative dip pays off
All positive — sum the whole array
Symmetric -100..100 — best window is 0..100 summing to 5050
